display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D2-06 Sustainable and Competitive Cell Production Techniques for Lithium-ion And Sodium-ion Batteries (BATT4EU Partnership) – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D2-06 Sustainable and Competitive Cell Production Techniques for Lithium-ion And Sodium-ion Batteries (BATT4EU Partnership)
executive_summary: This Innovation Action supports machinery and pilot production lines for lithium-ion and sodium-ion cells. It seeks lower production cost and energy use while maintaining or improving cell quality. Eligible consortia can include battery manufacturers, production-line suppliers and research teams. The topic budget is EUR 37.80 million with around EUR 18.90 million expected per project. It opens 2026-12-03 and closes 2027-03-31 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Climate, Energy and Mobility Work Programme, pp. 98–101, Specific conditions and Scope, defines the work. More affordable cells could benefit future battery projects providing flexibility, but this scope establishes work on factory pilot lines and gives no practical TSO delivery route. The connection to Time-dependent transmission rights contract (Lion Storage) supports Type 3 and C3.3. Both project dates are null because the call states no start, end or duration.
